project.name: Online Examination Platform
project.summary: Web system for creating exams, delivering timed tests to students, and providing auto‑graded results.

functional_requirements: Teachers can create and manage question banks.
Teachers can schedule exams with specific dates and durations.
Students can take timed exams online.
The system automatically grades objective questions.
Teachers and students can view exam results on a dashboard.
non_functional_requirements: The platform must prevent cheating through browser lockdown and monitoring.
The system must remain reliable and available throughout exam periods.
The user interface must be responsive with page load times under 2 seconds.
The architecture must scale to support concurrent exams for many students.

actors.name: Teacher
actors.description: Creates question banks, schedules exams, and reviews results.

actors.name: Student
actors.description: Logs in to take assigned timed exams and view personal results.

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: Manages user accounts, roles, and overall exam settings.

use_cases.name: Create Question Bank
use_cases.description: Teacher adds, edits, and organizes questions for future exams.

use_cases.name: Schedule Exam
use_cases.description: Teacher defines exam date, time window, and selects question bank.

use_cases.name: Take Timed Test
use_cases.description: Student starts the exam, answers questions within the allotted time, and submits.

use_cases.name: Review Auto‑graded Results
use_cases.description: Teacher accesses the dashboard to see scores and analytics for completed exams.

use_cases.name: Manage Users and Settings
use_cases.description: Administrator creates, updates, or removes user accounts and configures system parameters.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Teachers can create and manage question banks.
criteria: Questions can be added, edited, and deleted via a web form.
Supported question types include multiple choice, true/false, and short answer.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Teachers can schedule exams with specific dates and durations.
criteria: Exam start and end times are selectable on a calendar widget.
Scheduled exams are visible to assigned students before the start time.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Students can take timed exams online.
criteria: A visible countdown timer is displayed during the exam.
The exam is automatically submitted when the timer reaches zero.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The system automatically grades objective questions.
criteria: Grades are calculated instantly after submission.
Scores are stored and linked to the student's record.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The platform must prevent cheating through browser lockdown and monitoring.
criteria: Full‑screen mode is enforced and navigation away triggers a warning.
IP address and device fingerprint are logged for each exam session.

user_stories.story: As a teacher, I want to create and organize question banks, so that I can reuse questions for multiple exams.
acceptance_criteria: Teachers can add, edit, and delete questions within a bank.
Questions are searchable and can be grouped by subject or difficulty.

user_stories.story: As a teacher, I want to schedule exams, so that students know when to take them.
acceptance_criteria: Teachers can set exam date, time, duration, and associate a question bank.
Scheduled exams appear on the student dashboard with countdown timers.

user_stories.story: As a student, I want to take timed tests, so that I can complete assessments within the allocated period.
acceptance_criteria: The test starts only at the scheduled time and enforces the configured duration.
The interface automatically submits answers when time expires.

user_stories.story: As a student, I want to view my results after an exam, so that I can understand my performance.
acceptance_criteria: Results display score, correct/incorrect counts, and time taken.
Students can access their result page only after the exam is completed.

user_stories.story: As an administrator, I want to manage users and exam settings, so that the platform remains organized and secure.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create, edit, deactivate, and assign roles to user accounts.
Admins can configure global exam parameters such as maximum attempts and password policies.

user_stories.story: As a system, I want to enforce anti‑cheating measures, so that exam integrity is maintained.
acceptance_criteria: The platform detects multiple simultaneous logins for the same account and blocks them.
During an exam, screen capture, copy‑paste, and navigation away from the test window are disabled.

Database Designer.sql:
CREATE TABLE Users (
    user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    role TEXT,
    is_active BOOLEAN
);

CREATE TABLE Exams (
    exam_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title TEXT,
    scheduled_at DATETIME,
    duration_minutes INTEGER,
    creator_id INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (creator_id) REFERENCES Users(user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Questions (
    question_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    exam_id INTEGER,
    content TEXT,
    max_score REAL,
    question_type TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (exam_id) REFERENCES Exams(exam_id)
);

CREATE TABLE ExamAttempts (
    attempt_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    exam_id INTEGER,
    student_id INTEGER,
    started_at DATETIME,
    completed_at DATETIME,
    score REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY (exam_id) REFERENCES Exams(exam_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES Users(user_id)
);

Project Structure.architecture: A micro‑service style deployment: a React/Vite SPA served via Nginx, communicating over HTTPS with FastAPI services containerized in Docker. FastAPI handles authentication, exam scheduling, question bank CRUD, and real‑time exam monitoring via WebSocket endpoints. PostgreSQL stores relational data (users, exams, questions, results) accessed through SQLAlchemy. Redis provides session storage, rate‑limiting, and a Celery broker for background tasks such as auto‑grading and email notifications. All components are orchestrated with Docker Compose for development and can be scaled with Kubernetes in production.
Project Structure.architecture_diagram:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Client
        SPA[React SPA]
    end
    subgraph Edge
        Nginx[Nginx Reverse Proxy]
    end
    subgraph API
        FastAPI[FastAPI Service]
        WS[WebSocket Endpoint]
    end
    subgraph DB
        Postgres[PostgreSQL]
        Redis[Redis]
    end
    subgraph Workers
        Celery[Celery Workers]
    end
    SPA -->|HTTPS| Nginx
    Nginx -->|REST / WS| FastAPI
    FastAPI -->|SQLAlchemy| Postgres
    FastAPI -->|Cache / Broker| Redis
    Celery -->|Broker| Redis
    Celery -->|Result Store| Postgres

Documentation.readme: Online Exam Platform enables teachers to build question banks, schedule timed exams, and auto‑grade. Students log in, take exams within a secure, proctored environment, and view results instantly. Admins manage users, roles, and system settings. Built with React frontend, Node.js/Express API, PostgreSQL, and JWT authentication.
Documentation.api_documentation: POST /api/auth/login – body {email, password}. Returns JWT. GET /api/exams/:id – fetch exam details (auth, role: student). POST /api/exams/:id/submit – submit answers, returns score. GET /api/teachers/banks – list question banks. POST /api/teachers/banks – create bank. POST /api/admin/users – create user. All endpoints require Bearer token, role‑based access.
Documentation.installation: Clone repo. Run `npm install` in root. Set up PostgreSQL DB and create .env with DB_URL, JWT_SECRET. Run `npm run migrate` to apply schema. Start backend with `npm start`. In /client, run `npm install` then `npm run build`.
Documentation.deployment: Containerize with Docker. Use docker-compose with services: api, db, client. Deploy to cloud (AWS ECS, Azure App Service) behind HTTPS load balancer. Enable autoscaling for API pods. Use environment variables for secrets. Configure CI/CD pipeline to build and push images on merge.
Documentation.sprint_plan: Sprint 1 (2w): Auth, user roles, DB schema. Sprint 2 (2w): Question bank CRUD, exam scheduling UI. Sprint 3 (2w): Exam taking flow, timer, auto‑grade engine. Sprint 4 (2w): Admin dashboard, user management, settings. Sprint 5 (1w): Cheating mitigation (browser lockdown, IP monitoring). Sprint 6 (1w): QA, load testing, documentation.
Documentation.architecture: Frontend: React SPA with Redux, React Router, Material UI. Backend: Node.js/Express REST API, JWT auth, role middleware. Database: PostgreSQL relational schema for users, exams, questions, results. Security: HTTPS, CSP, SameSite cookies, server‑side validation, exam session tokens, activity logging. Scalability: Stateless API, containerized, load‑balanced, DB read replicas.
